notes: Excerpt of the FY 2025 Annual Budget (Local Budget Preparation Form 2, Lapu-Lapu City): printed pages 17-72 of 408 (56 scanned pages, p-01 = Page 17 ... p-56 = Page 72). Every page carries the heading 'OFFICE : OFFICE OF THE CITY MAYOR'; the pages are stamped 'Received as part of supporting documents to the FY 2025 ... Feb 03 2025' and 'Certified True Copy'. No signature block with printed names appears in these pages, so certifiedBy is empty.

The signature block for this LBP Form 2 section (Prepared by Atty. Misaellee M. Tejano, CGADH II; Reviewed by Judith D. Furuta, City Budget Officer; Approved by Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan, City Mayor) and the GRAND TOTAL are printed on page 75, which is in Part 2, so certifiedBy is left empty here and no grand-total table is included.

Covers the Office of the City Mayor (pages 17-23) followed by the Other Special Purpose / Special Purpose Appropriations administered under the Mayor (pages 24-72). Each program block is its own table; blocks printed with only one expenditure class and a single Total have no subtotal row, and summary.offices takes that class from the printed block total. Where a block prints an MOOE 'TOTAL' followed by a Capital Outlay sub-total and a second TOTAL (Assistance to DILG, Assistance to Public Attorney Office, Urban Poor Services), the first TOTAL is recorded as the MOOE subtotal.
Columns: 2023 Past Year Actual, 2024 First Semester Actual, 2024 Second Semester Estimates, 2024 Total, 2025 Budget Year Proposed. Amounts in full pesos. Blank cells are null.

Account codes are transcribed as printed, including the printed sub-item suffix (e.g. '-5-01-02-010 -1', '-1-07-05-030 -24s1'); codes printed with a leading dash carry the fund/office prefix of the first code in the block.

SPECIAL PURPOSE APPROPRIATION - Development Project (spa-development-project) continues beyond printed page 72, the last page of this part: its Capital Outlay list has no printed Sub Total or Total here, so its summary.offices entry has capitalOutlay and total null. Its MOOE Sub Total has no 2025 Budget Year amount printed (blank). The block's Capital Outlay Sub Total is printed in Part 2 (page 75: 2023 55,839,794.66, 2024 Second Semester and Total 383,694,720.00, 2025 362,363,778.00); the 2023 and 2024 items transcribed here sum exactly to those figures, and the 2025 items here (213,563,778.00) plus the 2025 items on pages 73-75 make up the 2025 figure.

Local Disaster Risk Reduction Mgt. Fund (spa-ldrrmf): the 30% Quick Respond Fund is a separate printed block (section 'qrf', 54,029,534.00 proposed) reported in summary.offices as 'qrf'; the office's MOOE + Capital Outlay (58,258,911.00 + 67,810,000.00) is therefore less than its printed Total 180,098,445.00 by exactly the QRF amount.

Capital Outlay sub-totals with no 2025 Budget Year amount printed (Local Disaster Risk Reduction Mgt. Office, Lapu-Lapu Livelihood & Cooperative Services, Assistance to Public Attorney Office, Traffic Development Improvement Projects) are null in summary.offices.

The 2025 Budget Year column has a vertical scan streak that partly erases one digit position on several pages (e.g. Year End Bonus, Mid Year Bonus, PAG-IBIG/PhilHealth/ECIP rows of the City Mayor's Office). Those digits were read from the visible remnants and every such value is confirmed by the printed PS sub-total and office total.

Several 6/8 digit pairs are indistinguishable at the scan resolution; where a row (1st + 2nd semester = total) or a printed sub-total fixed the digit it was read accordingly: City Mayor's Office PERA-Regular 2024 First Semester 1,579,798.34; Traffic Development 'Other Supplies and Materials Expenses' 2023 Past Year 83,540.00.

Lapu-Lapu Livelihood & Cooperative Services, 2023 Past Year Actual: 'Training Expenses - Training on Cosmetology - Beauty Care' reads 249,90?.90 and 'Training and Product Development' reads ?93,84?.85, where each ? is a 6 or an 8 that the low-resolution scan does not distinguish. The printed MOOE Sub-total of 2,312,430.13 requires 693,84x.85 and exactly one of the two final digits to be 8 (249,908.90 + 693,846.85 or 249,906.90 + 693,848.85), so both cells are recorded as null (unreadable).
